description:
Hi, I am Abu Sufyan, a BS Software Engineering student (1st Semester) at Riphah International University, Sahiwal. I am an Android and web app developer with skills in Kotlin, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, and I have built several apps and games (GitHub: github.com/sufyan-vip).

I am currently forming my team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, Sahiwal — 2 to 3 of my friends will be joining me tomorrow. We are planning to work on the "Space Mission Design Game" challenge.
